assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 SET India 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：Sony Entertainment Television India / Sony Pictures Networks India（现为 Sony Holdings）。企业隶属关系链是什么？
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言。
  6. 主要内容类别（印度电视连续剧）。
  7. 内容供应模式：广播电视机构的节目存档。
  8. 代表性系列。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，SET India 排名第 3 名，历史累计观看量约为 192B（1920 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 SET India 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

evidence.snippet: SET India @SETIndia 190M subscribers Sony Entertainment Television is one of the leading Hindi General Entertainment channels in India. Since its launch in October 1995...
evidence.supports: Channel ID UCpEhnqL0y41EpW2TvWAHD7Q, canonical URL https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCpEhnqL0y41EpW2TvWAHD7Q, handle @SETIndia, approximate 190M subscribers

evidence.snippet: Created On: Sep 20, 2006. Subscribers: 190M. Views: 193B. Videos: 176K.
evidence.supports: Channel creation date September 20, 2006; ~193B total views; ~176K videos

evidence.snippet: Date joined: September 20, 2006. Sony Entertainment Television India... is the YouTube channel of the Indian pay television network of the same name that is mostly composed of compilations/moments from Hindi Sony Entertainment Television's shows and films. The network itself was launched in October 1995 and is owned by Sony Pictures Networks (formerly MSM Motion Pictures), a Subsidiary of Sony Pictures Entertainment.
evidence.supports: Creation date confirmed; content supply model is broadcaster archives (compilations/moments from network shows); corporate ownership chain

evidence.snippet: Sony Pictures Networks India Private Limited (SPNI) is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, Japan.
evidence.supports: Corporate chain: Sony Group Corporation → (indirect) → Sony Pictures Networks India Private Limited (SPNI)

evidence.snippet: Sony Pictures Networks India Private Limited (SPN or SPNI) is an Indian media conglomerate owned by Sony Pictures Entertainment by Sony Group Corporation. It was founded on 30 September 1995 as Sony Entertainment Television India Private Limited (SET India Pvt Ltd.). In December 2007, renamed as Multi Screen Media Private Limited. In December 2015, renamed as Sony Pictures Networks India (SPN). In 2022, SPN changed its corporate name to Culver Max Entertainment Pvt. Ltd.; the name is used exclusively by the holding company... In 2026 it reverts to Sony Pictures Networks India.
evidence.supports: Full corporate name history: SET India Pvt Ltd (1995) → Multi Screen Media (2007) → SPN (2015) → Culver Max Entertainment (2022) → SPNI reversion (~2025-2026)

evidence.snippet: Sony Pictures Networks India has officially reverted to its legacy corporate identity, replacing the Culver Max Entertainment name with Sony Pictures Networks India Private Limited across its corporate profile, legal disclosures, website, and digital assets.
evidence.supports: Rebranding back to Sony Pictures Networks India confirms the corporate identity timeline

evidence.snippet: Sony Entertainment Television (abbreviated as SET) is an Indian Hindi-language general entertainment pay television channel that was launched in 1995 and is owned by Sony Pictures Networks... Headquarters: Mumbai... Language: Hindi.
evidence.supports: Language: Hindi; Operating location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; Country: India; Primary content category: general entertainment / Hindi TV serials

evidence.snippet: Crime Patrol - Episode 252 - 31st May 2013. Upload date: May 31, 2013. Channel: SET India. Views: 1,301,205.
evidence.supports: Earliest identified still-public upload: Crime Patrol Episode 252, uploaded May 31, 2013

evidence.snippet: SET India (31 May 2013). Crime Patrol - Episode 252 - 31st May 2013. SET India (1 June 2013). Crime Patrol - Episode 253 - 1st June 2013.
evidence.supports: Corroborates earliest known uploads from May-June 2013; Crime Patrol is a representative series on the channel

evidence.snippet: The Kapil Sharma Show, Shark Tank India, Kaun Banega Crorepati, Indian Idol, Bade Achhe Lagte Hain, Adaalat, CID, Crime Patrol and Super Dancer are some of the popular shows by Sony.
evidence.supports: Representative series list for SET India YouTube channel

evidence.snippet: SET India (181M Subscribers). Most viewed video: Crime Patrol Dial 100 - क्राइम पेट्रोल - Dav-Pech - Episode 25 - 23rd November, 2015. Views: 231M.
evidence.supports: Most viewed video on the channel: Crime Patrol Dial 100 Episode 25 'Dav-Pech' with 231M views
